course.title: Python pet shelter
course.subject: Python
objectives: Store a number in a variable
Repeat an action with a for loop

lessons.title: Count the pets
lessons.explanation: A variable is a name for a value. pets = 3 stores the number 3. print shows a value on the screen.
lessons.question: Keep the pets variable and print its value.
lessons.starter_code:
pets = 3
# Print the number of pets below
hints: Which function shows a value on the screen?
Put the variable pets inside print's parentheses.
lessons.success: You stored a number in a variable and printed it!

lessons.title: Number the food bowls
lessons.explanation: A for loop repeats indented instructions. range(1, 4) produces 1, 2 and 3. The ending number 4 is not included.
lessons.question: Use a for loop to print the bowl numbers 1 through 3 on separate lines.
hints: The printing instruction belongs inside the loop.
Replace pass with print(bowl), keeping the same indentation.
lessons.success: Your loop numbered all three bowls. You can now store values and repeat an action!
